1. (Currently amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, __wherein the first component is a humeral surface component and the second component is a removably attached stem, and wherein the humeral surface component connects to the removably attached stem by a morse taper__.

2. (Currently amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface __component__ and said second component is a removably attached stem.

3. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature.

4. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said coronal radius of curvature has a range of 10 to 50 mm.

5. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said axial radius of curvature has a range of from 10 to 50 mm.

6. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a depth with a range of from 5 to 40 mm.

7. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface has a thickness with a range of from 0.1 to 10 mm.

8. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein a ratio of a depth of said humeral surface to said coronal radius of curvature is from about 0.7 to about 0.9.

9. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ is spherically or elliptically shaped.

10. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface is made of a material selected from the group consisting of cobalt chrome alloy, ceramic, metal, and magnet materials.

11. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface further comprises fins or spikes on a concave undersurface of said humeral surface.

12. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 further comprising a concave undersurface __on said humeral surface component__ for bony ingrowth material.

13. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface __component__ has a smooth articulating surface.

14. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 3 wherein said attachable stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

15. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 14 wherein said attachable stem is made of a material selected from the group consisting of titanium, stainless steel, tantalum, porous metal and trabecular metal.

16. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 15 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a smooth, textured or threaded surface.

17. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 16 wherein said removably attached stem is round, square, or triangular.

18. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises fins.

19. (Previously presented) The implant of claim 17 wherein said removably attached stem further comprises a bony ingrowth surface.

20. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem has [[a variable length]] __one of a plurality of different lengths__ wherein said stem extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem.

22. (Currently amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface __component__ connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper[[, and a screw]] __and a screw__.

27. (Currently amended) A __glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint to provide__ a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus and an implant.

28. (Currently amended) The glenohumeral joint __implant__ of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently amended) A __humerus bone implant__ comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface __component__ and a stem, wherein said stem is __adapted to be__ anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of said humerus bone, __and wherein the humeral surface component connects to the stem by a morse taper__.

30. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 29 wherein said stem has a diameter with a range of from 0.1 to 5.0 cm.

31. (Previously presented) The repaired humerus bone of claim 30 wherein said stem is linear.
